description: This file contains schema definitions, validation functions, and data structures for dashboards in the Superset project, including schemas for dashboard metadata, responses, and related entities.

classes.name: SharedLabelsColorsField
classes.description: Custom field accepting list of strings or a dictionary for label colors.

classes.name: DashboardJSONMetadataSchema
classes.description: Schema for dashboard JSON metadata, including filters, chart configs, and visual settings.

classes.name: TagSchema
classes.description: Schema for tags associated with dashboards.

classes.name: DashboardGetResponseSchema
classes.description: Schema for dashboard response data sent to clients.

classes.name: TabSchema
classes.description: Schema for tab structure within dashboards.

classes.name: BaseDashboardSchema
classes.description: Base schema for dashboard creation and update, with slug sanitization.

classes.name: DashboardNativeFiltersConfigUpdateSchema
classes.description: Schema for updating native filters configuration.

classes.name: DashboardColorsConfigUpdateSchema
classes.description: Schema for updating dashboard color settings.

classes.name: ChartFavStarResponseResult
classes.description: Schema for favorite star response for charts.

classes.name: GetFavStarIdsSchema
classes.description: Schema for retrieving favorite star IDs.

classes.name: ImportV1DashboardSchema
classes.description: Schema for importing dashboards in v1 format.

classes.name: DashboardCacheScreenshotResponseSchema
classes.description: Schema for dashboard cache screenshot response.
